title: Regulating the solution structural integrity and slow magnetic relaxation behavior of two Dy6 clusters with a pyridine–triazole ligand

material_class.structural_family: hexanuclear Dy6 cluster with two edge-sharing {Dy4(NO3)} units bridged by μ4-NO3−

synthesis.procedure: H2L (0.30 mmol, 0.0912 g), Dy(OAc)3·4H2O (0.30 mmol, 0.1235 g), Dy(NO3)3·6H2O (0.30 mmol, 0.1370 g) and NaN3 (0.60 mmol, 0.0390 g) were added to 14 mL DMF, stirred at room temperature for 20 min, then sealed in a 25 mL Teflon-lined stainless steel vessel and heated at 140 °C for 3 days. Slow cooling to room temperature gave yellow single crystals.
synthesis.temperature: stir 20 min at room temperature; hydrothermal 140 °C
synthesis.vessel_or_method: hydrothermal/solvothermal reaction in 25 mL Teflon-lined stainless steel vessel
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: cooled slowly to room temperature to yield yellow single crystals suitable for X-ray diffraction

properties.summary: DC susceptibility shows χMT = 84.51 cm3 K mol−1 at 300 K, falling to 47.57 cm3 K mol−1 at 2 K, consistent with Stark depopulation and possible antiferromagnetic Dy···Dy interactions. Magnetization at 2.5 K reaches 33.44 Nβ at 70 kOe without saturation. AC data under zero dc field show only slight frequency dependence and no χ″ maximum above 2 K even under dc fields up to 5000 Oe; a rough barrier ΔE/kB = 0.96 K indicates slow relaxation of magnetization but not typical SMM behaviour, attributed to muffin (Cs) geometries at Dy1/Dy3.

measurements.name: effective energy barrier ΔE/kB
measurements.conditions: estimated from ln(χ″/χ′) vs 1/T assuming a single relaxation process; no χ″ maximum above 2 K under 0–5000 Oe

material_class.structural_family: hexanuclear Dy6 cluster of four edge-sharing {Dy3(OH)} triangles with μ3-OH−/μ2-OH− bridges

synthesis.procedure: H2L (0.30 mmol, 0.0912 g), Dy(OAc)3·4H2O (0.60 mmol, 0.2470 g) and NaN3 (0.60 mmol, 0.0390 g) were added to 14 mL EtOH, stirred at room temperature for 20 min, then sealed in a 25 mL Teflon-lined stainless steel vessel and heated at 140 °C for 3 days. Slow cooling to room temperature gave yellow single crystals.
synthesis.temperature: stir 20 min at room temperature; hydrothermal 140 °C
synthesis.vessel_or_method: hydrothermal/solvothermal reaction in 25 mL Teflon-lined stainless steel vessel
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: cooled slowly to room temperature to yield yellow single crystals suitable for X-ray diffraction

properties.summary: χMT = 81.11 cm3 K mol−1 at 300 K and 43.87 cm3 K mol−1 at 2 K. Magnetization at 2.5 K reaches 30.15 Nβ at 70 kOe without saturation. Zero-field AC susceptibility shows frequency-dependent χ′ and χ″ maxima, Cole–Cole α = 0.13–0.68, and Arrhenius parameters τ0 = 2.26×10−6 s and ΔE/kB = 70.1 K, establishing typical SMM behaviour associated with near-ideal D4d square-antiprismatic Dy sites.

measurements.name: pre-exponential factor τ0
measurements.conditions: Arrhenius fit of τ above 10 K; τ extracted from frequency-dependent AC data 2–15 K, zero dc field

measurements.name: effective energy barrier ΔE/kB
measurements.conditions: Arrhenius fit of τ above 10 K, zero dc field
